name: unicom
description: China Unicom (中国联通 / 联通元景) official brand template. Deep brand red (C00000) + bright red accent (EE0000) on clean white canvas, Microsoft YaHei typography, dual co-brand logo (中国联通 + 联通元景) anchored top-right, red header rule and left accent bars. The default template for any 联通 / 中国联通 / 联通数智 / 联通元景 deck. Style modifiers such as 科技风 / 婉约风 only tune the secondary accent and mood; the red-frame brand identity stays fixed.
